title: Runtime PICA suite selector negotiation matrix
question: Which integer selectors does the running AE host accept for each distributed AEGP suite name, and can an SDK-25.6-built plug-in observe newer host suite selectors without dereferencing unknown tables?
source_note: At AEGP EntryPoint the probe attempts AcquireSuite for 48 suite-name families and selectors 1..32. Every success is immediately balanced with ReleaseSuite; acquired tables are never dereferenced by this matrix probe.

hypotheses.prediction: Accepted selector integers are scoped to suite name and do not form a single monotonic generation namespace.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Every tested suite follows one global monotonic selector sequence matching table generation numbers.

hypotheses.prediction: The running host exposes at least some selector behavior not inferable by treating the SDK 25.6 latest table as a universal alias.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Every suite accepts only one universal latest-table selector pattern with no family-specific behavior.

factors: host major/minor version passed to AEGP EntryPoint
procedure: User installs the canonical probe while AE is closed and launches a disposable blank session.
At AEGP EntryPoint the probe logs every 48-suite x selector-1..32 acquisition attempt.
Every successful acquisition is immediately released without dereferencing its table.
User runs the paired L5 fixture once, then closes AE and removes the probe.
analyze_plugin_host_experiment.py requires all 1536 attempts to be present before the capture is accepted as complete.
